assumptions.text: Automated impact alerts (PAGER, GDACS) are a fair first estimate of impact.

test.rule: Compare with Copernicus activations and ReliefWeb reports as they come in

assumptions.note: Both are model estimates published within minutes and revised; wildfire alerts are especially numerous.

assumptions.text: An event's point locates its country.

test.rule: The kit's country lookup on the event point

assumptions.note: Offshore events get no country; cyclones, droughts and floods reach beyond their point.
